legal.privacyBody: Pariksha Saathi collects only the minimum information needed from students — name, class, school, block, and contact details — solely to provide educational services. Mobile numbers and full names are never shown on the public leaderboard. Answer copies are accessible only to the student concerned and the assigned teacher.
legal.disclaimerBody: Content on this portal is managed by teachers on behalf of the District Education Department, Surajpur. External links and reference material are provided for convenience only.
legal.accessibilityBody: This portal is built to conform to GIGW 3.0 and WCAG 2.1 AA standards — including keyboard navigation, screen reader support, sufficient color contrast, and text resizing. Please report any accessibility issue to the helpline.
